targets.resolutionSource: U.S. Census Bureau American Community Survey 1-Year Estimates Detailed Table B28005. VINTAGE DISCIPLINE: base rates MUST come from ACS 1-YEAR estimates (ACSDT1Y products) for each history year, never 5-year tables (5-year values lag the 1-year series by roughly two years and corrupted prior runs of this target), and never from prior Thesis run artifacts. Fetch per-year values live from the keyless JSON endpoint https://data.census.gov/api/access/data/table?id=ACSDT1Y{YEAR}.B28005&g=010XX00US (2022, 2023, 2024), reading the B28005_014E and B28005_017E columns and computing 100*B28005_017E/B28005_014E. Keep the published question text exactly: U.S. Census Bureau American Community Survey 2025 ACS 1-Year Estimates Detailed Table B28005, population 65 years and over in households with a computer and a broadband Internet subscription divided by total population 65 years and over in households, first print, percent.
targets.resolutionRule: Resolve to 100 * B28005_017E / B28005_014E for geography United States in the first public 2025 ACS 1-Year Estimates Detailed Table B28005 print, rounded to one decimal percentage point. Use the original Census first-posted estimate and ignore later revisions or corrections unless Census replaces the first public file before the public release completes.
